integrity: New proof is self-contained, exact symbolic examples and a deterministic-seed numerical verifier are included; classical diagonal majorization and spherical moments are acknowledged. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact extremal and minimax laws concern quadratic functions, exact arithmetic and frames chosen independently of unknown Hessian orientation. The signed-frame extension for smooth objectives bounds mean-estimator bias, not single-run MSE or end-to-end optimization convergence.
title: Sharp minimax curvature risk of randomized orthonormal one-sided numerical differentiation
